capabilities.name: tag.context.overview
capabilities.use: Confirm the nexus, the caller's role and that TAG is invited.

capabilities.name: tag.ledger.chart_of_accounts.read
capabilities.use: Accounts and active flags to validate entry lines.

capabilities.name: tag.ledger.transactions.read
capabilities.use: Subledger and GL detail behind an adjustment.

capabilities.name: aletia.search
capabilities.use: Find supporting documents the caller may see in the nexus.

capabilities.name: tag.evidence.attach
capabilities.use: Record each entry's support and the check result.

capabilities.name: tag.review.request
capabilities.use: Route entries to the approver the organization's rules name.

inputs.name: chart of accounts with active flags
period status list
inputs.source: ledger period metadata or the tag-close-management plan

inputs.name: adjustments needed, with calculations
inputs.source: tag-reconciliation results, tag-financial-statements exceptions, subledger detail or the user's request

inputs.name: supporting documents
inputs.source: aletia.search in the nexus, or documents the user supplies

outputs.name: result.json
outputs.description: Per-entry status and problems, and a posting request that stays not_posted.

outputs.name: entry memos
outputs.description: Purpose, calculation, support and required approver per entry.

conditions: Every entry needs the approver named by the organization's delegation-of-authority rules before a posting request.
Entries above the organization's thresholds, non-recurring entries and prior-period corrections always go to review.
Posting is a separate operation (tag.ledger.journal_entry.post) authorized by the runtime; this skill never performs it.
